delivery_delay_tracking.description: Inquiries regarding delayed packages, tracking status, carrier delays, and estimated arrival dates.
delivery_delay_tracking.inclusion_criteria: Mentions where is order, package not arrived, tracking number, carrier status (USPS/UPS/FedEx), delayed shipping.
delivery_delay_tracking.exclusion_criteria: Package was marked delivered but arrived broken (damaged_defective_item) or request for full money back due to delay (refund_return_request).
delivery_delay_tracking.typical_resolution: Check carrier tracking status, provide estimated delivery date window, advise waiting 24-48 hours past carrier ETA, or offer redelivery/replacement.
examples: Where is my package? It was supposed to arrive yesterday.
My order #104-39281 has been stuck in transit for 4 days without updates.
Tracking says delivered but nothing is on my porch. Can you help locate it?

refund_return_request.description: Requests to return an item, obtain return shipping labels, check status of a pending refund, or cancel an order for a refund.
refund_return_request.inclusion_criteria: Mentions refund, return label, drop off at UPS store/Kohl's, return policy window, cancellation for credit.
refund_return_request.exclusion_criteria: Complaints about payment card errors (payment_billing_issue) or Prime subscription refund (subscription_prime_issue).
refund_return_request.typical_resolution: Explain standard 30-day return policy, generate prepaid return mailing label, explain refund processing time (typically 3-5 business days after receipt).
examples: I want to return this jacket, how do I get a return mailing label?
When will my refund be credited to my bank account for the returned monitor?
Can I return an opened electronic item to an Amazon drop-off location?

damaged_defective_item.description: Reports of receiving damaged, broken, expired, defective, or incorrect products.
damaged_defective_item.inclusion_criteria: Mentions broken on arrival, damaged box, defective product, wrong item received, shattered, missing pieces.
damaged_defective_item.exclusion_criteria: Complaints solely about delivery delay where package is undamaged (delivery_delay_tracking).
damaged_defective_item.typical_resolution: Apologize for product condition, initiate free replacement or returnless refund if applicable, provide return instructions.
examples: I opened my parcel and the glass coffee press is completely shattered.
You sent me the wrong book instead of the cookbook I ordered.
The blender worked for two minutes and then started smoking, it is defective.

payment_billing_issue.description: Inquiries and disputes concerning payment charges, duplicate debits, declined cards, or gift card balances.
payment_billing_issue.inclusion_criteria: Mentions double charged, unexpected charge, payment method failed, gift card code invalid, invoice discrepancy.
payment_billing_issue.exclusion_criteria: Refund status for an item already returned (refund_return_request) or annual Prime membership fee charge (subscription_prime_issue).
payment_billing_issue.typical_resolution: Verify billing statement, explain pending authorizations vs posted charges, assist with re-entering card details or redeeming gift cards.
examples: I see two charges of $45.99 on my credit card statement for a single order.
My payment keeps declining even though my bank says funds are available.
My gift card balance was not applied to my purchase at checkout.

account_login_access.description: Problems with logging in, two-factor authentication (2FA/OTP), password resets, or account security concerns.
account_login_access.inclusion_criteria: Mentions cannot sign in, forgot password, not getting OTP code, two-step verification loop, account locked or hacked.
account_login_access.exclusion_criteria: Prime membership questions while logged in (subscription_prime_issue).
account_login_access.typical_resolution: Provide password reset link, guide through Two-Step Verification account recovery form, or advise security procedures.
examples: I cannot log into my account because I am not receiving the OTP text message.
My Amazon account is locked and asking for identity verification documents.
How do I reset my password if I lost access to my registered email address?

subscription_prime_issue.description: Questions and requests regarding Amazon Prime membership, renewal fees, cancellations, and digital benefits.
subscription_prime_issue.inclusion_criteria: Mentions Prime membership, annual subscription fee, student Prime discount, cancel Prime, Prime Video access.
subscription_prime_issue.exclusion_criteria: Standard order delivery queries that happen to use Prime delivery (delivery_delay_tracking).
subscription_prime_issue.typical_resolution: Guide to Manage Your Prime Membership page, explain pro-rated cancellation refund policy, assist with digital perk activation.
examples: Why was I charged $139 for an annual Prime subscription I did not authorize?
How do I cancel my Amazon Prime membership and get a refund for unused months?
My Prime video is saying I do not have an active subscription but I paid.

product_inquiry_availability.description: Pre-purchase questions about product specifications, compatibility, stock availability, pricing, or sellers.
product_inquiry_availability.inclusion_criteria: Mentions is this in stock, restock date, product dimensions, compatibility with device, third-party seller questions.
product_inquiry_availability.exclusion_criteria: Complaints about an item already received broken (damaged_defective_item).
product_inquiry_availability.typical_resolution: Provide product page specifications, suggest adding item to Wishlist for restock notifications, clarify seller details.
examples: Will this phone case fit the iPhone 15 Pro or just the base model?
When will the 64GB version of this tablet be back in stock?
Is this product sold directly by Amazon or by a third-party seller?

general_complaint_feedback.description: Customer dissatisfaction with courier behavior, poor customer service experience, app bugs, or policy disagreements.
general_complaint_feedback.inclusion_criteria: Mentions terrible service, rude delivery driver, driver threw package, useless customer support, formal complaint.
general_complaint_feedback.exclusion_criteria: Routine tracking questions without anger or complaint (delivery_delay_tracking).
general_complaint_feedback.typical_resolution: Acknowledge frustration with empathy, log delivery carrier feedback with logistics team, escalate to leadership/specialist if needed.
examples: Your delivery driver threw my package onto my driveway in the pouring rain!
I have spoken to three different agents today and nobody is helping me. This is unacceptable.
I want to file a formal complaint regarding your customer service representative's behavior.
